title: Zephyr C: desync recovery FSM (spec 09 14.7) absent from TDMA subsystem
description: Spec 09 14.7 R-09-133: implementations MUST implement the desync recovery FSM (SYNCED->DESYNCED on SFN wrap + invalid time provider; DESYNCED->RECOVERING on valid beacon ts>=floor matching SFN; RECOVERING->SYNCED after 3 consecutive valid beacons; RECOVERING->DESYNCED on timeout/invalid ts) in the TDMA subsystem (lichen_tdma_init() in lichen/subsys/lichen/link) and document timeout values (RECOMMENDED 3 superframes for RECOVERING). Classification: divergent/not-implemented for C - lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c:57-77 lichen_tdma_init sets only CCP-1.2 state; no DESYNCED/RECOVERING states anywhere in lichen/subsys/lichen/link (grep confirmed). Implemented+tested in Python (python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py:77-125 DesyncFSM, TDMA_BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES=3 sfn.py:14; tests python/tests/timing/test_sfn.py:284-297) and Rust (rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs:82-150 DesyncFSM; unit tests desync.rs:285-358). Suggested placement: add DesyncFSM to lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c alongside lichen_ccp_fsm_event, wire SFN-wrap + epoch-floor validation (lichen_epoch_floor_accepts time_sync.c:571), document 3-superframe RECOVERING timeout; vectors test/vectors/ccp16-desync.json + packets-timing.json desync_fsm_recovery_timeout.
